summary: FAQ on Temporal Super Resolution covering screen percentage ranges, dynamic resolution support, history sample count and memory, translucency ghosting, cel-shading outlines, Has Pixel Animation and history resurrection costs.
gotchas: Dynamic resolution is supported on consoles but not on Windows/desktop
TSR has no sharpening pass; use tonemapper sharpening instead
Low effects scalability can set r.SeparateTranslucency 0 and make TSR ghost on translucency; use r.TSR.ForceSeparateTranslucency
History resurrection doubles TSR history memory by default

summary: Explains how all temporal upscalers (TSR, TAAU, DLSS, FSR, XeSS) plug into the post-process chain, the Automatic View Mip Bias texture setting, post-process materials after TSR, and the Temporal Upscaler visualization show flag with DumpGPU tips for debugging ghosting.
gotchas: Automatic View Mip Bias only applies with TAAU or TSR, not MSAA/FXAA
View Property View Size returns pre-TSR resolution even in After Tonemapping post-process materials; use SceneTexture PostProcessInput0 Size
Overriding pre-exposure is discouraged except to work around specific issues

summary: Describes TSR's Thin Geometry Detection, which detects sub-pixel geometry (Nanite foliage, hair, fences) and relaxes history rejection to reduce flickering, plus how it handles translucency over-relaxation, its performance cost and its console variables.
gotchas: Enabled automatically when Nanite Foliage is on; use a value < 0 to disable it then
Adds extra compute passes; before-DoF translucency handling has significant performance impact
Temporal Responsiveness node requires platform support for uint64 image atomics
Does not fix moire from normal-map detail or uniformly sub-pixel parallel lines

summary: Explains Capsule Shadows: soft character shadows from a Physics Asset capsule representation assigned as the Skeletal Mesh's Shadow Physics Asset, with direct/indirect settings, performance figures and limitations.
gotchas: Not compatible with Virtual Shadow Maps
Movable Point and Spot Lights are not supported; Source Radius softening needs Stationary lights and built lighting
Only Sphyls and Spheres can be used for the capsule representation
Indirect capsule shadows rely on Lightmass volume lighting samples from a lighting build

summary: Step-by-step tutorial: create a reduced shadow Physics Asset for the Third Person mannequin, assign it as the Shadow Physics Asset, enable Capsule Direct/Indirect Shadows on the character Mesh component, and build lighting to test.
gotchas: Use Sphyl bodies for best results and keep body count low (example goes from 21 to 10)
Overlap capsule joints slightly to avoid gaps in the shadow
Capsule Indirect Shadows need a lighting Build
Written for UE4 Third Person template paths

summary: How to create Blueprint Custom Events with input parameters and optional replication, call them from anywhere in the Blueprint via Call Function, and fix stale call nodes after changing parameters.
gotchas: 'Unable to find function with name' warning on the node is fixed by compiling the Blueprint
Changing the number of inputs breaks all calling nodes until you Refresh Nodes

summary: How to author a 256x16 color grading LUT in an image editor from a neutral LUT, import it with the right texture settings, and apply it via a Post Process Volume's Color Grading LUT.
gotchas: LUT texture must use Mip Gen Settings NoMipMaps and Texture Group Color Lookup Table
LUTs work in LDR sRGB after tonemapping and do not carry to HDR displays; Epic recommends the Post Process Color Grading controls instead

summary: Overview of anti-aliasing methods (TSR, TAAU, FXAA, MSAA), which renderer supports each, where to choose the method in Project Settings, and the quality console variables and scalability group for each.
gotchas: MSAA is only available with the Forward Renderer and is not controlled by Engine Scalability
MSAA does not fix aliasing from materials, textures or translucency
TSR dynamic resolution is listed as console-only

summary: Legacy note on the RHI async compute API for Xbox One (begin/end async compute jobs and fences) and how to disable it for PIX GPU captures.
gotchas: USE_ASYNC_COMPUTE_CONTEXT is 0 on PC (not supported in D3D11.1)
Async compute jobs do not appear in PIX GPU captures
Buffers with UAV counters are not supported

summary: How-to for importing custom LOD meshes into a Static Mesh via LOD Import, setting per-LOD Screen Size instead of Auto Compute LOD Distances, per-LOD materials, and choosing which LOD is used for complex collision.
gotchas: LOD switching is by screen size, not distance
The LOD chosen for Complex Collision is used always; it does not switch at runtime
Automatic mesh reduction via Number of LODs is described as needing a Simplygon license

summary: Hub page for environment lighting: Light Mixer and Environment Light Mixer windows, how Sky Atmosphere and Exponential Height Fog combine, local fog volumes, and links to Sky Atmosphere, Volumetric Cloud, Directional/Sky Light, Heterogeneous Volumes and Sparse Volume Textures.
keys: Support Sky Atmosphere Affecting Height Fog
gotchas: A level supports up to two Directional Lights (sun/moon) and a single Sky Light
Exponential Height Fog contribution is additive with Sky Atmosphere height fog unless inscattering colors are black

summary: Hub page 'Direct Lighting': notes on light Mobility (Static/Stationary/Movable) affecting supported properties, with links to MegaLights, physical lighting units, GI, shadowing, reflections, distance fields, lighting channels, IES profiles, light functions, light shafts, sky atmosphere and clouds.
gotchas: Lightmass settings only affect Static or Stationary lights

summary: How to enable the Forward Shading renderer and MSAA, its performance rationale (mainly VR), and the lists of supported and unsupported features compared to the deferred renderer.
gotchas: Requires an editor restart
No SSR, SSAO, Contact Shadows, or dynamically shadowed translucency; no GBuffer scene texture access in materials
Fewer texture samplers available per material
MSAA costs about 25% more GPU time than TAA in Epic's tests

summary: Legacy FShaderCache for reducing shader hitches on OpenGL and Metal RHIs: console variables for caching, draw logging, predraw and async precompilation, cache file locations and versioning.
gotchas: Only supports OpenGLDrv and MetalRHI
r.UseShaderDrawLog adds fixed overhead; avoid in shipped builds
Binary cache during cooking is Mac-only

summary: How to auto-generate or repack lightmap UVs on import or in the Static Mesh Editor Build Settings, and set Lightmap Resolution and Lightmap Coordinate Index for baked lighting.
gotchas: Generation only repacks existing UV charts from the source channel; it does not split charts
Result is only as good as the source UV layout
Lightmap Resolution should be higher than Min Lightmap Resolution

summary: Using the Sun Position Calculator plugin's BP_SunPosition actor to place the sun from latitude, longitude, time zone, date and time, and changing it at runtime from Blueprint with Update Sun.
gotchas: Requires a BP_SkySphere in the level
Directional Light must be Movable to change at runtime
Use North Offset, not the rotate tool, to orient the gizmo

summary: Hub page comparing precomputed (CPU/GPU Lightmass) and dynamic (Lumen, SSGI, hardware ray tracing) global illumination, with links to each method and supporting topics like volumetric lightmaps and Swarm.
gotchas: GPU Lightmass needs an NVIDIA GPU with DirectX 12 and ray tracing support
Static Meshes need a lightmap UV for baked lighting

summary: How to use the DumpGPU console command to dump a frame's RDG textures and buffers to disk and inspect passes, textures and buffers in the browser-based GPUDumpViewer, including dump filtering cvars and save locations.
gotchas: Available in Debug, DebugGame, Development and Test builds; Shipping needs Target.cs defines that must not ship
Dumps are uncompressed and can be many GB
Only non-MSAA Texture2D FRDGTexture resources are dumped; arrays, 3D and cube textures are not
Viewer needs Chrome with a WebGL 2.0 GPU

summary: Introduction for renderer programmers: useful rendering console commands and command-line flags, Engine vs Renderer module classes, game/render thread ownership, material classes, primitive scene proxies, rendering paths, frame render order and RHI feature levels.
gotchas: Game thread code changing component properties must call MarkRenderStateDirty() to update the render thread
UMaterialInstanceDynamic cannot set static switch parameters or be a parent of another instance
Page content is old (lists -dx11 as default, -dx12 experimental, drawing policies)

summary: Using the HDRI Backdrop plugin actor to project an HDR cubemap onto a dome or box mesh with built-in Sky Light, reflections and ground shadow catching for product visualization, plus HDR texture setup.
gotchas: HDR texture must use NoMipmaps and a Maximum Texture Size matching its resolution or it looks muddy
It creates its own Sky Light; delete any other Sky Light in the scene
Intensity is not normalized between HDR images

summary: How to import VDB files as Sparse Volume Textures, build a volume-domain SVT material, render it with the Heterogeneous Volume actor (static or animated) in real time or with the Path Tracer, plus Niagara Fluids use, cvars and project settings.
gotchas: Experimental feature; shadow casting and path tracer support are experimental
Path tracing needs DirectX 12, Support Hardware Ray Tracing and Path Tracing enabled
Internal lighting cache is dense and capped at 1024x1024x512 voxels
Heterogeneous Volume actor does not trigger path tracer invalidation; uncheck Animate to stop the screen door effect

summary: Reference for building landscape materials: weight vs alpha blending of painted layers and the Landscape Layer Blend, Sample, Coords, Switch, Weight and Visibility Mask nodes, height-blend black-spot fix, mobile sampler limits and assigning the material.
gotchas: A layer name in the material with no matching target layer always has zero weight
All layers using LB Height Blend can produce black spots; make one layer LB Alpha Blend
Visibility Mask needs Opacity Mask connected but keep Blend Mode Opaque
ES3.1 mobile has a 16 sampler limit; each 4 target layers add a weightmap texture

summary: Shader-level guide to Large World Coordinates: DoubleFloat (FDF*) and FLWC* HLSL types and operators, LWC in material nodes, Camera Relative World Position, and porting UE4 HLSL to translated world space.
gotchas: LWC math in materials and shaders has a significant performance cost; prefer translated (camera-relative) world space
FLWC types have lower precision than DoubleFloat types

summary: Describes the five light types (Directional, Sky, Point, Spot, Rect) and what Static, Stationary and Movable mobility mean for baking, dynamic shadows and cost, with links to per-type and per-mobility pages.
gotchas: A single object can be affected by at most four Stationary Lights
Shadow-casting Movable lights are the most expensive; unshadowed Movable lights are cheap

summary: Hub page for lighting topics linking to Lumen, MegaLights, light types, direct lighting, environment lighting, GI, distance fields, ray tracing, shadowing (VSM, contact, capsule), post process, volumetric fog and HDRI Backdrop.

Overview of Lumen dynamic GI and reflections: enabling it in Project Settings, what it supports (sky light, emissive, translucency, water, two-sided foliage), all Project and Post Process Volume Lumen settings, update speed, disabling static lighting and Material AO.
keys: Use Hardware Ray Tracing when available
gotchas: Projects converted from UE4 do not enable Lumen automatically
Static mobility lights are not supported; lightmaps are hidden when Lumen is on
Global lighting changes can take seconds to propagate; raise update speed settings at extra GPU cost
Max Reflection Bounces needs Hardware Ray Tracing with Hit Lighting for Reflections

summary: Technical detail on Lumen's Surface Cache and cards, screen tracing, Software (distance field) vs Hardware Ray Tracing with their limits and requirements, Far Field, platform support, visualization view modes and troubleshooting common artifacts like leaking, black reflections and slow propagation.
gotchas: Software RT does not support World Position Offset; walls should be at least 10 cm thick; large single meshes give poor distance fields
Hardware RT needs Windows 10+ DX12 and NVIDIA RTX 2000+ or AMD RX 6000+; skinned meshes add per-frame BVH update cost
Lumen is not compatible with Forward Shading; Lumen Scene covers 200 m by default (up to 800 m)
Foliage and Instanced Static Meshes need Nanite for Surface Cache support
